descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S03 「拍一份之前的记录：读出来的文字进输入框等检查，每个值都和印的一样」 Photograph a prior note: the read text lands in the box for review with every value as printed

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T4 A photographed prior note is read by Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is used word for word with only the request format adapted, and the read text ke …（TFA-94425 AC 1；TFA-94425 AC 2；TFA-94425 AC 3；TFA-94425 AC 4）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient; live Vertex photo read (Gemini Flash) on the local stack. The read is never mocked here, because a mocked read tests nothing of T4

When Previous Notes → Photograph → upload the synthetic note image, wait until the button no longer says Reading, and save the checkpoint without pressing anything else

Then The read text sits in the note box for review, with every value exactly as printed (BP 142/88, creatinine 1.1, BNP 1250, EF 30%). A misread value (1.1 → 7.1) is a Fail of T4

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs on s03-read: mustContain the printed facts and values ('pleural effusion', 'creatinine 1.1', 'BNP 1250', 'EF 30%', '142/88'; vitals belong in the box and are kept off the chart only), and mustNotContain {snfResident}. Only the photo read (TFA-94425, ready for qa) is judged here, so the only requirement is T4. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U76；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S03 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
